test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What does the idiom "to keep the wolf away from the door" mean?

options.text: To escape from a dangerous situation
To stay away from risky opportunities

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To avoid financial hardship**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"to keep the wolf away from the door"** means to avoid financial hardship and ensure that basic needs, such as food and shelter, are met. (आर्थिक कठिनाइयों से बचने के लिए) • **Example:** He worked extra hours to keep the wolf away from the door and provide for his family. • **Explanation:** The imagery of a wolf at the door symbolizes the threat of poverty or destitution. The phrase implies efforts to maintain financial stability. (यह मुहावरा वित्तीय स्थिरता बनाए रखने के प्रयासों को दर्शाता है।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To avoid financial hardship**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To escape from a dangerous situation** (खतरनाक स्थिति से बचने के लिए) • **Example:** He jumped into the river to escape from the dangerous situation. • **Option 3: To protect oneself from enemies** (दुश्मनों से खुद को बचाने के लिए) • **Example:** The king built a strong fortress to protect himself from enemies. • **Option 4: To stay away from risky opportunities** (जोखिम भरे अवसरों से दूर रहना) • **Example:** She decided to stay away from risky opportunities to ensure stability in her career. c8:Tf10, The correct answer is **Option 1**.
